node.title: Re^3: Check for another program availability
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I see, but, would that be portable? I mean, the which program itself may not be available.

That's correct, it's not portable, and I don't agree with the above advice, also due to the use of backticks (see [id://1180578]). [man://which] [https://salsa.debian.org/debian/debianutils/-/blob/master/which|is just a short shell script] (at least on Debian), it's not magic.
